events.verdict: Leonard (TOR) brings one hand to the opposite side of Whiteside's (MIA) body but immediately slides it off.
Ibaka (TOR) places two hands on Winslow's (MIA) body at the end of his drive, but the contact is marginal.
Johnson (MIA) makes contact with Siakam's (TOR) body and affects his driving shot attempt.
Ibaka (TOR) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Ibaka (TOR) reaches in and cleanly dislodges the ball from Whiteside (MIA).
Siakam (TOR) and Whiteside (MIA) engage and disengage without affecting each others ability to retrieve the rebound.
Winslow (MIA) makes contact with Leonard's (TOR) arm during his drive and affects his ability to gather the ball.
Green (TOR) does not step into Wade's (MIA) landing area on his jump shot attempt.
Leonard (TOR) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is taken.
Ibaka (TOR) is in a wide stance but doesn't initiate leg to leg contact during the pick against Winslow (MIA).
Leonard (TOR) makes contact with Winlsow's (MIA) arm during his drive but the contact is marginal and he is able to continue his drive.
Ibaka (TOR) makes contact with Winslow's (MIA) arm but does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Whiteside (MIA) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Johnson (MIA) is in the paint for longer than 3 seconds without actively guarding an opponent.
VanVleet (TOR) makes contact with Richardson's (MIA) arm during the drive and affects his SQBR.
Siakam (TOR) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Green (TOR) makes high five contact and does not step into Wade's (MIA) landing area on his jump shot attempt.
The ball is not in the cylinder when Wade (MIA) makes contact with the ball.
